decisions.reason: The multi-model safety shoe line sits in the firm's core business, and its tooling and range investment favour keeping it, since two years is too early to judge a footwear line.
The comfort insole costs little to maintain and complements the footwear range, so with little invested but little to gain from dropping it, the firm keeps it.
The supportive insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and tailored-solution offering, so modest results can still be read as a temporary ramp-up.
The ergonomic series has its own page and several models, which signals substantial investment and public commitment to the announced innovation direction.
Costly certification and long tender-based sales cycles for firefighter boots create sunk costs and justify persisting while results mature.
As the home-page flagship of the firm's direction, the moulded insole carries the strongest public commitment and need for justification.
